title: The Stolen Reliquary
text: The reliquary of Saint Wend, a gold box holding her blackened heart, is gone from the cathedral. For three days the bishop has preached that a Great House took it, and that the city will burn until it is returned. Every House has a theory, and every House has an enemy.

options.label: Name the House you suspect before the bishop's fires find their own target.

outcomes.text: You give the bishop a name. He thanks you with a look that says he will remember who gave it.

options.label: Buy it back from the fences and return it quietly so the city does not burn.

outcomes.text: Your agents find it in a pawnshop under the bridge and bring it back without a word. At dawn the bishop finds it on the altar and weeps.

options.label: Keep your head down until it blows over.

outcomes.text: It does not blow over, but it blows past your door.

together.text: Every House accuses another. The bishop curses them all from the altar. Nobody returns the heart, which is heard beating under the city for years.

blamed.text: The bishop names the House from the pulpit. Its people are spat on in the street; its recruits leave it. Its stores pay for a new reliquary.
